summary: Iteration 5 tested. TWO CRITICAL BUGS found. (1) BACKEND: BillItem Pydantic model at server.py:128-134 is MISSING tip_amount and tip_via fields — Pydantic silently strips them from POST/PUT /api/bills item payloads. Result: per-line tips completely non-functional. Bill response returns tip_amount=0, tip_qr_total=0, items have no tip fields, reports.today.tips does not reflect line tips (got 20 for existing bill-level tip; expected >=100 after our POST with 2×50 line tips). (2) FRONTEND (auto-fixed): new-bill.tsx used useLocalSearchParams but did NOT import it — caused a full RED-SCREEN 'useLocalSearchParams is not defined' crash preventing New Bill screen from rendering AT ALL. Added missing import from expo-router; screen now renders. All other iteration-5 features verified working: PUT /api/bills/{bid} admin auth (200), staff blocked (403), unknown 404, bill_no & created_at preserved, edited_by_name/edited_at fields present in response. Frontend: Bill Detail (admin) shows Edit pill button → navigates to /new-bill?edit=<id> with customer/items/beautician prefilled. Staff Bill Detail hides Edit (count=0). Users screen at 390x844: horizontal Name + ADMIN/STAFF pill + YOU tag inline, email below, 3 compact action buttons on right — clean & non-cramped. Report screen (Last 7 Days): chip row + summary card + bill rows render without visual overlap. Tab bar visible on all screens without content clipping. Regression: 52/52 backend tests pass (test_glowup_backend + test_glowup_regression + test_auth_admin_management). Iter-5 new tests: 4/8 pass, 4 fail due to bug #1.

critical.issue: BillItem Pydantic model (server.py:128-134) does NOT declare tip_amount and tip_via fields. Pydantic v2 default is to ignore/drop unknown fields, so per-line tips sent by frontend get SILENTLY STRIPPED before apply_member_discount → items_eff never carries them → line_tip_total & line_tip_qr always compute to 0 → bill.tip_amount, tip_qr_total, tip_cash_total = 0. Feature completely broken. Fix: add `tip_amount: float = 0` and `tip_via: Optional[Literal['cash','qr']] = None` to BillItem model.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing import of useLocalSearchParams from expo-router caused a full red-screen 'useLocalSearchParams is not defined' crash whenever user navigates to New Bill tab. Prevents ALL new-bill/edit-bill functionality from working. Auto-fixed by adding to import: `import { useRouter, useFocusEffect, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router';`

rca_of_issue: Bug 1 RCA: During iter-5 backend implementation, developer added aggregation logic (lines 476-478, 567-568) that reads `it.get('tip_amount', 0)` and `it.get('tip_via')` from items_eff, plus roll-up fields on the response. BUT the BillItem Pydantic model was NOT extended with these fields. Pydantic v2 by default silently drops unknown keys from validated input. So client's per-line tip payload is stripped at request parsing, apply_member_discount().model_dump() emits items without tip_amount/tip_via, and all downstream aggregation calls return 0. Verified via /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_bill_tips_edit.py::TestPerLineTips (4 failures). Fix: add fields to BillItem. Bug 2 RCA: Missing named import for useLocalSearchParams from expo-router in new-bill.tsx. Fixed inline.
